\textnormal{Evaluate the Cauchy principal value defined by the displayed equal-distance cutoffs around the interior pole. \textnormal{For real twice continuously differentiable f on the unit interval with the displayed derivative bound, define the quadrature error E. Find the ordered pair consisting of its sharp supremum C and the answer yes or no to whether an admissible f attains it.}\quad |f\prime\prime(x)|\le1\quad(0\le x\le1),\qquad E(f)=\int_0^1f(x)\,\mathrm{d}x-\left(\frac{1}{12}f(0)+\frac{5}{8}f(\frac{1}{3})+\frac{7}{24}f(1)\right),\qquad C=\sup_f|E(f)|.

\textnormal{Let f range over continuous real functions satisfying the displayed range, endpoint values and mean. \textnormal{For which positive T does there exist a finite bound B, depending only on T, such that every continuous nonnegative u satisfying the displayed integral inequality also satisfies the displayed uniform bound?}\quad u(t)\le\int_0^t(1+u(s)^2)^{2}\,\mathrm{d}s\quad(0\le t\le T),\qquad\sup_{0\le t\le T}u(t)\le B.
